reason: Using current_upb directly as a feature to predict next_12m_prepayment_flag causes perfect leakage because when a loan prepays, its UPB immediately drops to 0.
Raw Brier score was uncalibrated and significantly worse than baseline. Platt scaling was applied to make probabilities and Brier metrics mathematically consistent.
The LLM copilot generated a final decision label ('Reject Application') which violated the governance rule that the LLM is only an assistant, not a final decision-maker.
